answer_1.quote: For mBART, we pre-train the model on the WMT dataset using the Multilingual Denoising Pre-training objective, focusing on three language pairs: German-English (De-En), French-English (Fr-En), and Chinese-English (Zh-En). The pre-trained mBART model is fine-tuned on downstream translation tasks for the respective language pairs and the performance is evaluated using the BLEU score.
